prompt: Write post-response tests for creating an order and reading it back — the requests “Create order” and “Get order” of my collection, on my HTTP environment Stage — that I will keep in the collection. The test of the read must check that it gets the very order that was created. It is a test stand: creating orders there is fine.
_why: the read's draft runs on a send of {{orderId}}: the id has to come from the create, through `variables`, and a test that passes on any order passes on another
